content_sections.heading: About IREL
content_sections.text: IREL (India) Limited is a Mini Ratna Category-I Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Administrative Control of the Department of Atomic Energy, with its Corporate Office at Mumbai. It runs mineral sand mining and processing plants at Chavara (Kerala), Manavalakurichi (Tamil Nadu) and Orissa Sands Complex (Odisha), and a Rare Earths Extraction Plant in Odisha.

content_sections.heading: IREL Consultant (CSR & PR) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Mandatory qualification: Post Graduate in any discipline. Ability to read, write and speak Odiya is also mandatory. Experience: service experience of minimum 20 years in a Government or Government Aided organisation. Desirable: degree in Law, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management or Political Science. Preferred experience: service in positions such as Land & Revenue, General Administration or Academics department of a Government or Government Aided organisation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Consultant
content_sections.text: The company undertakes CSR activities and awareness programmes in its operational areas with District Administration, government departments, local authorities, NGOs and community institutions. The consultant is engaged to assist in public relations, liaison and stakeholder coordination. Duties are: Resource-related matters: facilitate coordination with concerned departments and authorities on resource-related issues relevant to company operations. Stakeholder engagement: maintain constructive relations with local communities, public representatives, media, community organisations and other stakeholders, and pass their concerns to the appropriate authority in the company. Follow-up of pending issues: keep a systematic record of pending matters, representations, meetings, commitments and correspondence with external authorities, and follow up for resolution. Public relations and communication: help disseminate approved information on company activities, CSR initiatives and developmental contributions. Meeting and field coordination: coordinate meetings, field visits, inspections and review meetings with the District Administration, and help prepare meeting notes and action-taken reports. Grievance facilitation: route stakeholder representations and community-level issues to the concerned company departments. Periodic reporting: submit periodic reports to the designated officer on liaison activities, CSR project progress, legal matters, pending issues and stakeholder feedback.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is through interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The selected person is appointed as Consultant (CSR & Public Relations) on retainership basis for six months, extended on performance and requirement in steps of not more than six months at a time. Remuneration is fixed and consolidated, up to Rs 50,000 per month. Two pairs of uniform with applicable stitching charges are issued at the time of initial engagement, with re-issue only after 12 months. TA/DA is payable as applicable for Senior Manager of IREL when travelling on official engagement. One day casual leave per month; no other form of leave is allowed.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised?
faq.answer: One post of Consultant (CSR & PR) on retainership basis is advertised under Advt. No. CO/HRM/39/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 18:00 hrs on 06 December 2026. Registration opened on 26 November 2026 at 10:00 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. How do I send my application?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed format attached to the notice and email it with supporting documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The candidate should be between 55 and 65 years as on the date the vacancy was advertised on the company website.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A Post Graduation in any discipline is mandatory, along with the ability to read, write and speak Odiya. A degree in Law, Industrial Relations, Personnel Management or Political Science is desirable.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: At least 20 years of service in a Government or Government Aided organisation. Service in Land & Revenue, General Administration or Academics departments is preferred.

faq.question: Q7. What will the pay be?
faq.answer: A fixed consolidated remuneration of up to Rs 50,000 per month, plus TA/DA as applicable for Senior Manager of IREL on official travel.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the engagement?
faq.answer: The initial retainership is for six months. It may be extended on performance and requirement in steps of not more than six months at a time.
